steps: Play through the whole game and earn the other 54 trophies — the platinum unlocks automatically the moment the last one pops.
Use the checklist in this app to track what is left; filter by grade to clear the silver and gold trophies first, since they gate the most work.
Keep a manual save before the final mission so you can mop up any partner or choice-based trophies without replaying the story.
1.tips: There is no difficulty trophy, so play on whatever difficulty you enjoy. The longest grinds are the collectibles and the 100% completion gold.

steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing — it is the first story mission and cannot be skipped.
Follow the on-screen objectives: the mission teaches basic movement, driving and the partner-swap mechanic.
Finish the mission's final objective and the trophy pops on the results screen.
2.tips: Unmissable story trophy. If you are replaying, mission replay from the pause menu also counts.

steps: Play through every story mission in Chapter 1 in order — the chapter trophy unlocks when the final Chapter 1 mission ends.
Do not worry about side content yet; story missions are marked with the main objective icon on the map.
The trophy pops automatically after the chapter-closing cutscene.
3.tips: Unmissable. Chapter progress is shown in the pause menu under Story.

steps: Continue the story into Chapter 2 and complete each of its missions in order.
Chapter 2 introduces new contacts and activities — try them as they unlock, but they are not required for this trophy.
Finish the last Chapter 2 mission and the trophy unlocks after the closing cutscene.
4.tips: Unmissable story trophy. Save regularly so a failed mission never costs you more than one retry.

steps: Play through Chapter 3's missions in order until the chapter finale.
Vice City opens up more fully in this chapter — use the downtime between missions to discover areas for the exploration trophy.
Complete the final Chapter 3 mission; the trophy pops after the cutscene.
5.tips: Unmissable. If you want to save time later, grab nearby collectibles while travelling between mission markers.

steps: Complete every story mission in Chapter 4 in order.
Chapter 4 missions are longer and harder — stock up on armour and ammo at Ammu-Nation before the big set-pieces.
Finish the chapter finale and the trophy unlocks.
6.tips: Unmissable story trophy. Use cover and Combat Focus in the heavier shootouts.

steps: Finish all four chapters, then play the final mission when it appears on the map.
The final mission is a long multi-stage set-piece — bring full armour, your best weapons and snacks for health.
Complete the last objective and watch the ending; the gold trophy pops on the results screen.
7.tips: Unmissable story trophy, but make a manual save before starting it — the post-game free roam is the best time to clean up remaining trophies.

steps: Play the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears — it is part of the main story path.
Follow the mission objectives; it is a driving-and-delivery style mission, so keep your vehicle intact where the game asks.
Complete the mission and the trophy unlocks.
8.tips: Unmissable story mission trophy. If you fail, retry from the last checkpoint.

steps: Play the story mission The Cartel Heist when it unlocks in the story.
This is a heist setup-and-execution mission: complete each prep objective, then the heist itself.
Finish the escape and the trophy pops.
9.tips: Unmissable. Heist missions checkpoint generously — a failed escape just restarts the escape section.

steps: Play the story mission Child's Play when it appears in the story.
Follow the objectives through the mission's scripted sequence.
Complete the mission to unlock the trophy.
Play the story mission Headliners when it unlocks.
Work through the mission's objectives — it mixes driving and on-foot sections.
Finish the mission and the trophy pops.
Play the story mission VCIA Takedown when it appears.
The mission takes place around Vice City International Airport — expect heavy resistance and vehicle chases.
Complete the takedown objective and escape to finish the mission.
12.tips: Unmissable. Keep a fast car nearby for the getaway section.

steps: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory when it unlocks late in the story.
This is a large combat mission — bring full armour, assault-rifle ammo and use Combat Focus for the entrenched enemies.
Complete the final objective to unlock the trophy.
13.tips: Unmissable story mission trophy. Take it slow and use cover; rushing the open sections gets you killed.

steps: Reach 100% completion: finish all story missions, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and exploration goals the game counts toward completion.
Check the in-game stats/progress screen regularly — it lists every category and your percentage in each.
Clear the biggest buckets first (story, then collectibles, then activities), and use this app's checklist to track the trophy-gated ones.
The gold trophy pops the moment overall completion hits 100%.
14.tips: This is the longest trophy in the game and the real platinum gate. Do not leave it all for post-game — pick up collectibles and activities as you pass them during the story.

steps: Perform stunts: jumps, near-misses, airtime, drifts and wheelies all count toward the 250 total.
The fastest farming spot is a long straight with ramps or jumps — repeat a jump loop with a fast bike or sports car.
Each successful stunt shows a small notification; the counter is cumulative across the whole game, so normal play already builds it up.
Keep going until the 250th stunt registers and the silver trophy pops.
15.tips: Stunt jumps marked on the map are the most reliable source. A bike makes airtime and wheelies easy to chain.

steps: There are 9 activity types to sample once each: the game's activities include races, fishing, shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation spots, hunting and stunt jumps (exact roster per the in-game activities menu).
Open the activities menu or map legend and try each type at least once — finishing is not required, just participating.
The trophy pops after the ninth distinct activity type is tried.
16.tips: Do this early: it is a cheap trophy and it teaches you which activities you enjoy for the longer grind trophies.

steps: Visit a Shooting Range (Ammu-Nation) and open the challenges list — there are 42 challenges across the weapon categories.
Each challenge has bronze, silver and gold score thresholds; you need gold on all 42.
Start with pistols and SMGs to learn the scoring, then work through rifles, shotguns and the precision challenges.
Use the range's practice mode to learn target patterns before spending attempts on gold runs.
The silver trophy pops when the 42nd gold medal is earned.
17.tips: Take your time and aim for accuracy over speed — missed shots hurt your score more than a slow run. Upgrade weapons first if attachments are allowed in challenges.

steps: Find the Top Fun drone race locations — there are 14 spread across Leonida, marked once discovered.
Enter a race at each location and finish first; races are short time-trial style courses through checkpoints.
Learn each course's racing line on a first attempt, then retry for the win — retries are free.
The trophy pops after winning at the 14th location.
18.tips: Use gentle stick inputs through gates; overcorrecting is the main cause of lost races. Each location is independent, so clear the easy ones first.

steps: Enter races from the map or race contacts — street races, off-road and water races all count as long as each is a different race event.
Win 20 distinct race events; replays of the same race do not count twice.
Use a well-upgraded vehicle matched to the race type (sports car for street, off-roader for dirt, boat for water).
The trophy pops on your 20th distinct race win.
19.tips: Check the race list before entering so you never waste time replaying one you already won. Early story races count if they are distinct events.

steps: Unlock fishing (taught in the opening mission Gone Fishing) and find Cal's fishing challenge.
Fishing challenges are timing-based: cast, wait for the bite, then reel with steady tension — do not let the line snap or go slack.
Beat Cal's score in the challenge; if you lose, you can retry the challenge.
The trophy pops when you win the challenge against Cal.
20.tips: Buy better rods and bait when available — they make the reeling mini-game noticeably easier.

steps: Find an arcade — arcades are marked on the map in Vice City and other towns.
Pick any arcade game and play it through to its ending or completion screen; you do not need a high score.
The trophy pops when the game's completion screen appears.
21.tips: Choose the shortest arcade game if you just want the trophy; the others are worth playing for fun later.

steps: Meet Andy through the story and take his missions as they appear (marked with his icon).
Work through Andy's mission chain in order — each mission unlocks the next.
Complete his final mission and the trophy unlocks.
22.tips: Stranger/contact missions can be easy to overlook between story beats — check the map for Andy's icon whenever you are in his area.

steps: Meet Kenton through the story and take his missions as they appear.
Complete Kenton's mission chain in order until the final one unlocks.
Finish his final mission to unlock the trophy.
23.tips: Kenton's missions tend to involve boats and the coast — keep a fast boat or a car near the shore.

steps: Meet Billy through the story and take his missions as they appear.
Complete Billy's mission chain in order — expect bike-heavy missions.
Finish his final mission to unlock the trophy.
24.tips: Billy's missions favour motorcycles; keep a good bike in your garage for quick travel to his markers.

steps: Strangers & Freaks strands appear as '?' markers across Leonida — there are more than 8 in total, so you can pick the ones you like.
Each strand is a short chain of 1–3 missions for a stranger; finish all missions in a strand to count it.
Complete 8 full strands and the silver trophy pops.
25.tips: Start strands as you discover them during the story — some strands only appear in certain chapters, so do not leave them all for post-game.

steps: Meet Randy through the story and take his missions as they appear.
Complete Randy's mission chain in order until the final mission unlocks.
Finish his final mission to unlock the trophy.
26.tips: Randy's chain involves supply runs — a fast car with good handling helps more than a fast top speed.

steps: Meet Tyrone through the story and take his missions as they appear.
Complete Tyrone's mission chain in order until the final mission unlocks.
Finish his final mission to unlock the trophy.
27.tips: Check the map for Tyrone's icon after each story chapter — new missions in his chain often unlock between chapters.

steps: Find meditation spots — there are 18 across Leonida, usually scenic viewpoints marked once discovered.
At each spot, use the meditate prompt and complete the short meditation sequence.
Visit all 18 spots; the trophy pops at the last one.
28.tips: Meditation spots are peaceful and quick — fold them into your exploration route for the Leonida map trophy.

steps: Meet Bret and take his hunting request — he asks you to hunt a specific unique animal.
Hunting needs patience: track the animal using the hunting clues and stay downwind so it does not flee.
Take the shot cleanly and return to Bret (or complete the hunt objective) to unlock the trophy.
29.tips: Use a scoped rifle and approach slowly from cover. Scaring the animal off just means finding it again — it can be retried.

steps: Collectible Cards are hidden across Leonida in packs — each set needs its full set of cards.
Search shops, interiors and hidden spots; cards glow subtly and make a sound cue when you are near one.
Complete any 3 full card sets (you do not need every set in the game).
The silver trophy pops when the third set is completed.
30.tips: Work set by set in one region at a time instead of grabbing random cards everywhere — it is much easier to track. This also counts toward 100% completion.

steps: WAiNK It locations are photo/opportunity spots marked on the map once discovered — there are well over 100 in Leonida.
At each location, use the WAiNK It prompt to register it; the counter is cumulative.
Clear locations region by region (Vice City first, then the surrounding towns and countryside) until you hit 100.
The silver trophy pops at the 100th location.
31.tips: This is a pure exploration grind — combine it with the 52-area exploration trophy and the meditation spots to avoid backtracking.

steps: Challenges are the game's assorted side objectives — races, stunts, shooting, hunting, exploration and more — tracked in the challenges menu.
Open the challenges list and work through the ones you are closest to finishing; each completed challenge counts.
Complete 50 challenges in total; the trophy pops on the 50th.
32.tips: You will naturally complete many challenges while chasing other trophies — check the list before grinding anything, so you never do work twice.

steps: This trophy needs your story partner with you — it is easiest during story chapters where you play as a duo.
Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner in the car or on foot nearby (commit crimes in a busy area until the fourth star appears).
Escape: break line of sight, hide until the wanted level drops, and stay together until the stars clear completely.
The trophy pops once the 4-star level is fully lost while your partner is still with you.
33.tips: Do this during the story while your partner is readily available — after the finale, partner availability can be limited. Use the countryside or tunnels to break line of sight quickly.

steps: With your story partner beside you, rob a shop: aim at the clerk and take the cash.
Immediately drive to the next shop and rob it too, then a third — all without the wanted level dropping to zero in between.
Keep the wanted level alive (a 1–2 star level is fine) but do not get caught or killed between robberies.
The trophy pops after the third consecutive shop robbery.
34.tips: Plan a route of three close-together shops in advance, and use a fast car parked outside each one. Easiest while your partner is available in the story.

steps: Discover vehicles by driving them — each new vehicle model you enter for the first time counts toward the 100.
Variety matters more than speed: try cars, bikes, trucks, boats and aircraft as you find them, including parked and traffic vehicles.
Use the vehicle list in the stats menu to see which categories you are missing, then hunt those types (docks for boats, airfields for planes).
The trophy pops on the 100th distinct vehicle discovered.
35.tips: You will pass 100 naturally if you drive everything you see instead of sticking to one favourite car.

steps: Combat Focus is the slow-mo aiming ability — activate it during a firefight (check the controls screen for the exact button).
Find a spot with at least 5 enemies grouped together, such as a gang hideout or a shootout mission.
Activate Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before the meter runs out — headshots drop them fastest.
The trophy pops on the fifth takedown inside a single Combat Focus use.
36.tips: Soften enemies up first if you can, but only the kills during Combat Focus count. A shotgun or SMG at close range clears groups quickly.

steps: Go to Vice City International Airport (VCIA) and find an aircraft on the tarmac or in a hangar.
Take off in the aircraft without following the normal departure routine — the trophy is about an unscheduled departure, so just get airborne.
Once you are in the air and clear of the airport, the trophy pops.
37.tips: Smaller planes are easier to steal and take off in than jets. Expect a wanted level on the ground — get moving fast.

steps: Rhino tanks appear at high wanted levels and around military areas — raise your wanted level to draw one out, or find one at its spawn.
The trophy's description hints at dealing with Rhinos: engage one and survive the encounter — destroy it or escape its attention.
Use sticky explosives, RPGs or heavy weapons; a Rhino's cannon is lethal, so attack from cover and keep moving.
38.tips: Stock up on heavy weapons at Ammu-Nation first. Fighting a Rhino on foot in the open is a quick death — use buildings for cover.

steps: Pick a jewelry store — there are several in Vice City's shopping districts.
Plan the robbery: enter quietly, avoid the cameras and guards' line of sight, and take the goods without raising the alarm.
If you are spotted, leave and try again — detection fails the attempt, not the trophy.
Escape cleanly without ever being detected and the trophy pops.
39.tips: Go at night and move slowly. If a guard turns toward you, freeze or back out of sight rather than running.

steps: Bank Vaults are high-value robbery targets — find them through robbery contacts or by scouting banks in the city.
Each vault robbery has a setup (cracking or breaching the vault) and an escape; complete both parts.
Rob 5 different Bank Vaults and escape after each one — repeats of the same vault do not count.
The silver trophy pops after the fifth successful escape.
40.tips: Bring a fast getaway car and plan the escape route before you start the robbery. Armour and a good rifle make the guard response manageable.

steps: Armored Trucks drive set routes around Vice City and Leonida — watch for them on main roads or near banks.
Stop the truck (ram it, block it, or take out the driver), then breach the rear doors to grab the cash.
Escape the wanted level that follows — the trophy pops once you are clear.
41.tips: A heavy vehicle works best for stopping a truck without wrecking your own car. Do it away from police stations to make the escape easier.

steps: Leonida has 52 named areas — the map fills in as you visit each one, from Vice City neighbourhoods to the swamps and small towns.
Drive or fly through every area; the game counts an area as explored when its name banner appears on screen.
Use a fast car on the highways and a plane or helicopter for the remote corners and islands.
The trophy pops when the 52nd area is registered.
42.tips: Combine this with the WAiNK It locations, meditation spots and collectible hunts — one systematic sweep of the map covers four trophies at once.

steps: Each of the 9 gangs runs Illegal Operations — drug labs, chop shops and similar sites marked once discovered.
Scout a gang's operation, clear or rob it, and escape; each gang only needs one operation robbed.
Repeat for all 9 gangs — the gang list is shown in the stats or operations menu once you start.
The trophy pops after the ninth gang's operation is robbed.
43.tips: Operations are defended, so bring armour and a silenced weapon if you want a quiet approach. Track which gangs you have done in this app's checklist notes.

steps: Head to Ocean Beach in Vice City — the beachfront bars there serve cocktails with an ocean view.
Order a cocktail at a beachfront bar and enjoy it at the viewpoint the game prompts.
The trophy pops once the cocktail scene completes.
44.tips: A relaxing one — do it when you are already in Vice City for other trophies. Any beachfront bar on Ocean Beach works.

steps: Find a vehicle showroom in Vice City — the big glass-fronted dealerships on the main commercial streets.
Drive a vehicle straight through the showroom glass in classic GTA style and keep going out the other side.
The trophy pops once you have smashed your way out of the showroom.
45.tips: Use a sturdy car at good speed and aim for the glass frontage. This is a one-location stunt, so save before trying in case the approach goes wrong.

steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and start a game of bowling.
Play through the game — follow-through means completing your throws properly, so finish the frames rather than quitting early.
The trophy pops when the bowling game completes.
46.tips: Bowling also counts toward the activity types for the Master of None trophy, so do it early.

steps: This trophy is about a partnership moment with mass appeal — it unlocks through a story or social-media style event where your duo's profile gains a large following.
Play the story and take the partnership/social opportunities as they appear (the game prompts them).
Complete the prompted sequence and the trophy pops.
47.tips: Story-linked, so just keep playing — if it has not popped by the finale, check the social/partnership menu for any unfinished prompt.

steps: Throughout the story the game presents choices — dialogue options, approach choices and moral decisions.
Make choices whenever they appear; the game tracks how many you have made (community tracking suggests a cumulative count toward 500, per PSNProfiles).
Keep choosing in missions, stranger encounters and free-roam events until the count is reached and the trophy pops.
48.tips: Do not skip dialogue or rush past choice prompts — each one counts. Some choices only appear once per playthrough, so engage with them as they come.

steps: This trophy is about succeeding on a second attempt — fail an activity or challenge once, then complete it on the immediate retry.
Pick a short activity you can fail on purpose (for example, lose a race or fail a shooting challenge), then retry it right away.
Win or complete it on the second try and the trophy pops.
49.tips: Use a quick race for this: deliberately lose the first run, then win the rematch. Do not do other activities in between, or the 'second try' may not register.

steps: This trophy triggers on a strange random event in Leonida — an odd encounter that makes you ask what just happened.
Explore unusual places at odd hours: remote swamps, deserted roads and the edges of the map at night are where odd events spawn.
When the event triggers, watch it through to the end and the trophy pops.
50.tips: Random-event trophies can take a while — fold the hunt into your exploration and collectible routes rather than waiting in one spot.

steps: A melee drive-by means attacking someone from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon.
Get a vehicle and a melee weapon (bat, knife or similar), then drive slowly past a pedestrian.
Swing the melee weapon from the vehicle window as you pass — the target needs to be knocked down by the hit.
The trophy pops when the drive-by connects.
51.tips: Slow down to a crawl beside your target — at full speed the swing usually misses. A quiet street with few police nearby keeps the wanted level low.

steps: Marked Bills are earned from robberies and certain missions — they cannot be spent directly and must be laundered through your contacts.
Open the laundering contact option and convert Marked Bills into clean cash, a little at a time.
Keep laundering until the cumulative total reaches $250,000 — the counter is tracked in the stats menu.
The trophy pops at $250,000 laundered.
52.tips: Robberies are the best source of Marked Bills, so this pairs naturally with the bank vault and armored truck trophies. Launder regularly instead of hoarding bills.

steps: Spend money across all shops: clothing stores, gun shops, car mod shops, food and convenience stores all count.
The $100,000 total is cumulative across the whole game — normal story spending already covers a large part of it.
If you are short, buy weapon upgrades and vehicle mods, which are the most expensive items.
The trophy pops when cumulative shop spending passes $100,000.
53.tips: Do not grind this early — finish the story first and check the stats menu; most players are close already. Modding one good car can close the gap fast.

steps: Garage properties are buyable safehouses with vehicle storage — there are 8 across Leonida, marked on the map or property websites.
Save up and purchase each garage property; prices vary by location, so the city-centre ones cost the most.
Buy all 8 and the trophy pops on the final purchase.
54.tips: Properties are also useful for storing rare vehicles, so buy them as you can afford them rather than all at the end.

steps: The Scooter Bros app is your in-game phone app for registering vehicles.
Drive 10 different vehicles and register each one through the app (open the app while in the vehicle and choose register).
Any vehicle type counts — cars, bikes and trucks all register the same way.
The trophy pops on the 10th registration.
55.tips: Register vehicles as you discover them for the 100-vehicle trophy — the two trophies progress together.
